content.title: Contact the Arvada Police Department
content.summary: For emergencies, contact the Arvada Police Department by calling or texting 911; for non-urgent police matters, use the non-emergency number 303-980-7300. Residents can report non-violent crimes online and access various resources, including information on noise complaints, vehicle impound procedures, and parking enforcement. Additional contact numbers include the Office of the Chief of Police at 720-898-6650 and the Community Response Impact Team at 720-898-6883.
content.body:
**For emergencies, call or text 911**. For other police matters, call [303-980-7300](tel:3039807300).

## Report a Crime Online

You can report **non-violent crimes** that are **not in progress** using a simple online form. Visit [Report a Crime](/555/Report-a-Crime) for a full list of reporting options.

## Additional Contact Information

- **Office of the Chief of Police:**720-898-6650
- **Police Sectors**: [Learn about Sector Policing in Arvada](/550/Sector-Policing). Find your police sector, including its station address and phone number.
- [**Community Response Impact Team**](/202/Community-Response-Impact-Team): 720-898-6883
- [**Animal Management**](/199/Animal-Management-Unit): 720-898-6850
- **Public Information Office**: 720-898-6668

## Popular Tools and Resources

- [Join Our Team](https://joinarvadapd.com/)**:** Are you interested in a career with the Arvada Police Department? Explore our open positions, the application process, and more.
- [Order a Police Report](/554/Order-Police-Records)
- [Submit an Anonymous Crime Tip](/585/Submit-a-Crime-Tip)

### [FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=67)

[Can I make a noise complaint?](#)
:   Yes. The City of Arvada has [noise control laws](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIICOOR_CH38EN_ARTIINOCO) and enforces them. From loudspeakers to fireworks or loud music, many noises can create a disturbance. In most areas, noise standards (how loud things can be and what sorts of disturbing noises can be made) are lower (quieter) from 9 pm to 7 am. A noise complaint can be made at any time. To report a noise complaint, please call 303-980-7300.

[My vehicle was impounded. What do I do?](#)
:   Vehicles impounded by the Arvada Police are released directly by Connolly's Towing. Contact Connolly's Towing at 303-424-3445 to find out what is needed to recover a towed vehicle.

    If your car is on a police hold, you will need to contact the Arvada Police Department Evidence Unit at 720-898-6926 to find out how to retrieve your vehicle. Depending upon the storage location of your vehicle, you will go to Connolly's Towing to pay the required fees to them and obtain your vehicle or you will pay the City of Arvada towing fees at Evidence and obtain a vehicle release. Vehicles released from the City's impound facility are only done by appointment. Remember, it is the vehicle owner's responsibility to keep registration information current.

    **Connolly's Towing**

    - Address: 5702 W 60th Ave, Arvada, CO 80003
    - Hours: Monday through Friday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., Sunday Closed
    - Phone: [303-424-3445](tel:3034243445)

[I got a parking ticket. Now what?](#)
:   Parking Enforcement is a shared responsibility between LAZ Parking and the Arvada Police Department.

    - For parking complaints in and around Olde Town Arvada, please [email LAZ Parking](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e69687948d879490878287a68a879c9687948d8f8881c885898b) or [720-364-8587](tel:7203648587)
    - For ongoing issues with permit restriction violations related to city parks and schools, please [email LAZ Parking](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#265647544d475450474247664a475c5647544d4f48410845494b) or [720-364-8587](tel:7203648587).
    - For parking permits visit [City Parking Permits](/465/Parking-Permit-Registration)
    - For urgent parking concerns (blocking a driveway/roadway/fire hydrant), contact the Arvada Police Department at [303-980-7300](tel:3039807300).

[Does the Police Department have a lost and found?](#)
:   Due to the volume of property that is turned in, the police department does not have a lost and found service. Every attempt is made to identify and notify the owners of found property but when the owner can not be identified successfully, the items are held for 60 days and then disposed of or sent to auction.

[When do I call 911 and when do I call the non-emergency number?](#)
:   If you are experiencing an emergency, please dial 911. For other non-emergency police matters, please call dispatch 303-980-7300.

[Can the APD help me with VIN Verifications?](#)
:   We no longer offer this service.

    The [Colorado State Patro](https://csp.colorado.gov/services-we-provide/get-a-vin-inspection)l can also help with this.

[Can the APD unlock a car?](#)
:   In **limited situations**, the APD can help. For example, if an animal or person is in immediate danger, the APD can help.

    For other situations that are not life-threatening, please call a locksmith in the area.

[Can the APD help with the locks on my home?](#)
:   No. This is not a service we provide. You can find a local locksmith to help you.

[How do I register my bicycle?](#)
:   The APD does not license or register bicycles. Please check with your insurance company for suggestions.

[Who can help me with car seat installations?](#)
:   The Arvada Fire Protection District (AFPD) can assist with car seat installation. Visit a local Fire Station for assistance or check the [AFPD website](http://www.arvadafire.com/).

    Local hospitals are also a resource for proper car seat installation.
